## Purpose of this Website

At Zephaniah 3:9, Jehovah God prophesied that during the time of the end he would change the language of his faithful people to a pure language. This change to a pure language would help his people call on his name in true righteousness and to worship him in unity. Additionally, Jehovah promised his people at Amos 3:7, that he would not do a thing unless he has revealed his confidential matter to his servants. Today, the most confidential matters that could be revealed are the events leading up to the end of this system of things. Now is the time for God's people to speak the pure language about deep Bible truths regarding the end of this system of things and pure worship. (John 16:13)

Therefore, the purpose of this website is to shed light on the true understanding of God's Word that comes to us through his Son and his faithful disciples here on earth. This true understanding gives a person insight regarding what is happening on the earth today, what the near future will bring, and what each person can do to prepare themselves. The light of truth is found in the Bible, God's prophetic word, which gives hope to sincere ones. (2 Peter 1:19)

We encourage you to study this information prayerfully. Do all you can to apply it in your life so that your worship of God may be found acceptable to him when he soon arrives to judge mankind. (Romans 12:1-2; Hebrews 12:5-7) Share it with others so that they can be prepared for the end of this system of things. (Matthew 24:14)

## How to study this information

Take your time with each chapter. Read the overview first, then work through the verse groups one at a time. As you read, mark what stands out and write down your own thoughts. Use the bookmark icon at the top of any page to save your place and come back to it later. Your bookmarks, highlights and notes stay private on your device, so you can study at your own pace and return to them whenever you like.

::: {.stamp .study-box}
[Adding highlights and notes]{.box-title}

Mark the words that stand out and write your own comments. They are saved privately on your device.
